entries:
Patch 0.22.20 (Town guidance now stays useful after the first unlock band)

  • Post-30 handoff: When a player is back in town after unlocking base dungeons, the objective panel now points them toward the Dungeon Guide instead of going quiet.
  • Post-100 handoff: Level-100 town guidance now points players toward Heroic and Mythic runs, build review, and forge prep instead of leaving the next step implied.
  • Closeout support: Added a written `0.22` first-hour closeout doc that records what shipped, what still needs live QA, and the current close recommendation.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for post-level-30 and post-level-100 town guidance plus 0.22.20 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.19 (First-hour milestone guidance is easier to recover in-client)

  • Milestone visibility: Start-flow guidance and the Help screen now call out the first-hour progression beats more explicitly, including the level 30 dungeon unlock and level 100 Heroic/Mythic unlock.
  • Recoverable next steps: The in-client Help screen now doubles as a first-hour route refresher so players can recover their next step without leaving the game or guessing.
  • Town-service clarity: Quest Giver, Vendor / Repair, Stash, Forge, Dungeon Guide, World Map, and Journal are now framed together in one quick-reference path.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for first-hour milestone guidance, Help screen milestone copy, and 0.22.19 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.18 (Nearby remote players now read more clearly in motion)

  • Named remote actions: Nearby remote-player abilities now show named action labels, and nearby remote jumps and basic attacks now surface readable motion cues instead of blending into movement noise.
  • Remote motion clarity: Replicated attack and jump states now help broadcast what nearby players are actually doing, not just where they are standing.
  • Spam control: Remote readability labels stay nearby-only and throttled so the extra feedback helps without turning multiplayer fights into constant text spam.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for named remote ability labels, nearby remote jump and attack labels, far-away suppression, and 0.22.18 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.17 (Nearby multiplayer combat reads better in crowded fights)

  • Remote action readability: Nearby remote-player abilities now surface readable action labels so allied and nearby player casts do not disappear into effect spam.
  • Crowded combat damage clarity: Nearby remote-player damage now shows up as readable floating numbers during crowded fights instead of only showing when the local player is directly involved.
  • Animation sync assist: Remote player damage and ability events now help force attacking-state presentation so nearby combatants feel more alive and truthful.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for nearby remote action labels, nearby remote damage readability, far-away spam suppression, and 0.22.17 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.16 (Combat attempts now explain why they failed or what happens next)

  • Failed-action clarity: Out-of-range attacks, out-of-range casts, cooldown attempts, and no-mana casts now surface explicit combat callouts instead of failing silently or feeling ambiguous.
  • Level-up payoff: Level-up moments now call out milestone unlocks more clearly, including the dungeon unlock at level 30 and endgame difficulty unlocks at level 100.
  • Reward readability: Boss rewards and room-clear rewards now surface through readable combat callouts as well as chat, so the first-hour reward loop lands harder.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for failed-cast readability, move-into-range combat feedback, reward callouts, and 0.22.16 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.15 (Starter loot and forge guidance now explains what is worth keeping)

  • Starter loot truth: Inventory, start-flow, and town guidance now explain that obvious Common gear is usually vendor cleanup while better drops are worth checking before selling.
  • Forge-material clarity: Shards, Hearts, and Gems are now called out more explicitly as forge materials worth saving instead of accidental vendor trash.
  • Better service handoff: Merchant, Stash, Forge, and Trading House guidance now do a cleaner job of telling you what belongs where during the first hour.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for starter inventory guidance, starter recovery guidance, and 0.22.15 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.14 (Pre-fight boss objectives now tell you to commit)

  • Boss-commit truth: Pre-fight boss objectives now use commit language instead of flat discovered-room placeholder copy.
  • Guidance sync: Boss guidance now tells you to reset and commit before the fight is live, matching the callout layer.
  • Boss-state separation: Boss journal entries now distinguish commit-before-engage from Boss Now execution guidance.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for pre-live boss objective guidance and 0.22.14 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.13 (Cleared dungeons now read like extraction, not a fake turn-in)

  • Extraction-state truth: Cleared dungeons now shift the objective panel into extraction language instead of a generic completed turn-in state.
  • Exit objective clarity: Exit objectives now tell you to backtrack out with the loot after the boss is down.
  • Journal guidance fix: Cleared dungeon guidance no longer falls back to Turn this in for 0 XP in the journal panel.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for cleared-dungeon extraction guidance and 0.22.13 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.12 (Transitional route beats now read like real approach states)

  • Approach-state truth: Dungeon objective fallback guidance now describes transitional approach beats instead of generic push deeper copy.
  • Boss bridge clarity: One-room bridge states now call out the last approach room before the boss instead of vague final-room phrasing.
  • Shrine-route clarity: Longer neutral stretches now point cleanly toward the shrine reset, so approach rooms read like authored pacing instead of filler.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for transitional objective summaries, journal guidance rendering, and 0.22.12 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.11 (Ambush objectives now keep their pressure-spike language)

  • Ambush objective truth: Dungeon objective guidance now gives ambush rooms the same pressure-spike language already used by live callouts.
  • Journal sync: Ambush objectives and journal guidance now say Elite room ahead — pressure spike incoming instead of drifting back to generic elite-discovered copy.
  • Route continuity: Ambush route previews still show the next beats after the spike, so the journal keeps telling the same dungeon story as the minimap, world map, and callout layer.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for ambush objective summaries, journal guidance rendering, and 0.22.11 version presentation.
